raw_definitions: Definisi : adv; ~ /raving, staring/ mad, (jocular), /benar-benar, betul-betul/ gila. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 4. sharply defined or evident, jelas kelihatan: the ~ outline of the mountain against the clear sky, bentuk gunung yg jelas kelihatan berlatarbelakangkan langit yg cerah; in ~ contrast, jelas berbeza: her way of dressing was in ~ contrast to that of her sister, cara dia berpakaian jelas berbeza drpd cara adiknya berpakaian; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 3. stiff, keras kaku: the battlefield was littered with the bodies of the dead, mayat yg keras kaku bergelimpangan di medan perang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. desolate, harsh, gondol; (of landscape) tandus dan suram; (of room, wall, etc) bogel, kosong: the ~ cliffs fell sheer to the ocean, cenuram gondol itu menjunam ke laut; a ~ landscape, pemandangan yg tandus dan suram; a room as ~ as a prison cell, bilik yg bogel spt bilik di penjara; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : adj 1. without elaboration, unpleasantly plain, sebenar: ~ reality, kenyataan sebenar; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 5. sheer, absolute, betul(-betul), benar-benar: the story is ~ nonsense, cerita itu betul-betul karut; it would be ~ madness to consider taking such an action, betul-betul gila jika bercadang utk mengambil tindakan begitu; 6. see STARK-NAKED; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
